tokens.name: colour-page
tokens.usage: The ground. Off-white, not white, so `colour-surface` reads as raised. Every page and preview sits on it.

tokens.name: colour-surface
tokens.usage: A plane above the page: cards, buttons at rest, dialogs. Lighter than the page in both themes.

tokens.name: colour-hover
tokens.usage: Ground of a control under the pointer; skeleton placeholders. Only ~1.1–1.3:1 from the page by design: the 2px `colour-focus` ring is what keyboard users rely on.

tokens.name: colour-ink
tokens.usage: Text, deliberate rules, filled controls. On `colour-page` 16.6:1 light / 17.2:1 dark; on `colour-surface` 17.9:1 / 16.0:1.

tokens.name: colour-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary lines: standfirst, role, person title, quotes, landing links at rest. On `colour-page` 6.4:1 / 8.0:1; on `colour-surface` 6.9:1 / 7.5:1 (AA body).

tokens.name: colour-ink-faint
tokens.usage: Metadata only: labels, dates, captions, keywords, footer line. Source pair below AA for body text: 3.2:1 light / 3.9:1 dark on `colour-page`, 3.4:1 / 3.6:1 on `colour-surface` — never use it for body copy.

tokens.name: colour-line
tokens.usage: Borders a reader is not meant to notice (notice, field, dialog) and the link rail. Decorative: 1.2:1 / 1.35:1 on the page, so never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: colour-accent
tokens.usage: The filled state: `.h3-cta`, a pressed or expanded `.h3-button`. Same as ink — there is no accent hue.

tokens.name: colour-accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `colour-accent`. 17.9:1 light / 17.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: colour-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px, on inputs and anything tabbable. Follows ink; it was blue once and was removed because it was the only colour on the site.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First chart series (= ink). Charts use the grey ramp `chart-1`…`chart-4`, never hues.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second chart series (= ink-muted).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third chart series (= ink-faint).

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth chart series; light value off-theme, dark value = line. Pair with a label or pattern: it is close to the ground in dark.

tokens.name: gridfield
tokens.usage: Fixed, never flips: ground of `.h3-gridfield`, the only acceptable empty-image state.

tokens.name: gridfield-line
tokens.usage: Fixed: the 1px grid lines every 14px on `gridfield`.

tokens.name: monogram
tokens.usage: Fixed: initials centred on `gridfield` (display italic, lining figures, 30px).

tokens.name: logo-black
tokens.usage: Fixed: the logo master's black and the light tile's mark.

tokens.name: logo-white
tokens.usage: Fixed: the dark tile's mark and the white mark on dark grounds.

families.display: 'Mrs Eaves OT', mrs-eaves, 'Mrs Eaves', Baskerville, 'Libre Baskerville', 'Times New Roman', Times, serif
families.body: Inter, inter-18pt, 'Inter 18pt', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Mrs Eaves OT Italic, regular weight, the only cut in use. Ligatures always on (liga + dlig + calt); never tracked, never bold, no roman or small caps. The italic WOFF2 is carried here for preview; it is a licensed face (Preview & Print), so never redistribute the file.

styles.name: statement
styles.usage: The landing statement: `--text-landing`, clamp(3rem → 4rem), 48–64px; `text-wrap: pretty`. Ink on `colour-page`.

styles.name: name
styles.usage: Landing name, page wordmark and article/page title `h1`: `--text-landing-name`, clamp(1.5rem → 2rem). Wordmark in `colour-ink-muted`, title in `colour-ink` — colour alone separates them.

styles.name: entry-title
styles.usage: Entry titles and subheads (`h3`, `--text-xl`): roles, skill groups, qualifications, referees. The largest thing in a section. Never a link.

styles.name: display-small
styles.usage: `h6` in prose: display italic at base size, `colour-ink-faint`.

groups.name: Body
groups.note: Inter at its 18pt optical size: prose and all UI. `common-ligatures contextual` only — a discretionary ligature in a label is a bug.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Body is Inter at 16px on a 1.5 leading, set on a 68ch measure.

styles.name: standfirst
styles.sample: Create terrain mesh from NASA satellite data
styles.usage: Standfirst and role line under a title, 4px below it, `colour-ink-muted`.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Blockquote: muted italic Inter, a 1px `colour-line` rule on the left, 1rem padding, no quote marks.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section label (`h2`, `.h3-label`): UPPERCASE via CSS, tracked 0.08em, `colour-ink-faint`, 3rem above, 1rem below. The smallest thing in its section. Never Mrs Eaves.

styles.name: card
styles.usage: Card, notice, field hint and footer text (`--text-sm`).

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: `.h3-card-title`. 500 renders as 400 from the kit; don't rely on it as a step.

styles.name: person-name
styles.usage: `.h3-person-name`: semibold, the one real weight step up — a name over its captions.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Dates, entry periods, keywords and skills runs, captions (`--text-xs`), `colour-ink-faint`.

styles.name: tiny
styles.usage: `--text-2xs`: the bottom step of the scale, rarely used.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: No brand mono: the system stack, at 0.9em of the surrounding text.

spacing.note: 4px base. No 5, 7 or 10: a step up is always the next token.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: 4px: standfirst under a title, gaps between cards in a panel and between chrome buttons.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: 8px: list items, keywords margin, card-row gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: 12px: card padding, person gap, notice block padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: 16px: paragraph spacing, page side padding, label margin below, gallery gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: 24px: wordmark to title, dialog padding, landing links gap, closing rule below.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: 32px: stacked columns seam, subhead margin above, figures.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: 48px: label margin above, entry spacing, rule margin above, grid gutter, page top padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: 64px: below the masthead rule (air is asymmetric: more below a rule than above).

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: 96px: page bottom padding.

radius.note: Doubling. No shadows anywhere in this system.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Smallest corner; rarely used.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Controls, inputs, notices, images and gallery tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and the avatar square (never a circle).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Panels, dialogs and the hover card (with one square corner).

text.note: The type scale as custom properties (1.25 ratio), for consumers of tokens.css.

tokens.name: text-2xs
tokens.usage: 11.1px. 1.25 modular scale.

tokens.name: text-xs
tokens.usage: 13.3px: dates, periods, keywords, buttons.

tokens.name: text-sm
tokens.usage: 14.4px: labels, cards, notices, footer.

tokens.name: text-base
tokens.usage: 16px: body.

tokens.name: text-lg
tokens.usage: 20px.

tokens.name: text-xl
tokens.usage: 25px: entry titles and subheads in display italic.

tokens.name: text-3xl
tokens.usage: 39px.

tokens.name: text-landing-name
tokens.usage: 24→32px, off-scale on purpose: the name, wordmark and page titles.

tokens.name: text-landing
tokens.usage: 48→64px (48pt at 1280px), off-scale on purpose: the landing statement.

tokens.name: leading-display
tokens.usage: Display statements and names only.

tokens.name: leading-tight
tokens.usage: Display subheads (`text-xl`).

tokens.name: leading-normal
tokens.usage: Body, UI and small headings; the html default.

tokens.name: leading-loose
tokens.usage: Rarely: paragraph spacing does the separating instead.

tokens.name: weight-light
tokens.usage: Renders as 100 from the kit. Avoid.

tokens.name: weight-regular
tokens.usage: Default for both faces.

tokens.name: weight-medium
tokens.usage: Buttons, card titles; renders as 400 from the kit.

tokens.name: weight-semibold
tokens.usage: The one real step up: a name over its captions.

tokens.name: weight-bold
tokens.usage: Exists; almost never used.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Running text. Set `ch` on the element carrying the type, never on a wrapper.

tokens.name: measure-page
tokens.usage: Outer page column; 76rem from 96rem viewport, 94rem from 120rem.

tokens.name: measure-landing
tokens.usage: The landing statement; always 4rem narrower than the page (72rem, 90rem at the same steps).

tokens.name: measure-form
tokens.usage: Inputs.

tokens.name: breakpoint-md
tokens.usage: Grids switch on: six tracks, `space-12` gutter.

tokens.name: breakpoint-2xl
tokens.usage: Page and landing widths step up.

tokens.name: breakpoint-3xl
tokens.usage: 1920px: the last width step.

tokens.name: z-canvas
tokens.usage: The WebGL backdrop.

tokens.name: z-content
tokens.usage: Page content.

tokens.name: z-chrome
tokens.usage: The fixed chrome row.

tokens.name: z-hovercard
tokens.usage: The hover card that follows the pointer.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim and dialog (dialog +1, its loading bar +2).
